## Copy Repair Required

Current platform copy still uses advisory wording:

- `build-scripts/platform/build-exit-ticket-shells.js` generates a shell title
  with `Korte check`;
- `build-scripts/platform/build-landing-page.js` labels the Check card
  `Korte check` and `Kies wat je nog wilt oefenen`.

Future implementation must either:

1. generate target-equivalent copy for `surface: target_equivalent_exit_ticket`
   while keeping advisory short-check copy for advisory surfaces; or
2. keep the surface hidden/unpublished until copy semantics are reviewed.

It may not present a target-equivalent exit ticket as merely an advisory short
check, and it may not present an advisory short check as proof.
